nodes.content: A short RFAM record is labeled 5S_rRNA with a 118 nt sequence. Build a forest target that teaches a model to reason from RNA family and length toward structural-function constraints instead of treating it as arbitrary nucleotide text.
The source row provides a 5S_rRNA family label, clan CL00113, plant genome-shotgun description, and compact RNA sequence length. The label is more informative than raw base composition alone.

The ribosomal-role tree treats 5S rRNA as a structured noncoding RNA participating in ribosome architecture. The training signal should connect family identity to ribonucleoprotein context, not to protein-coding translation.

The structure tree should preserve the idea that short rRNA function depends on base-paired stems, loops, and conserved positions. Exact folding is not present in the row, so the safe target is family-conditioned structural expectation.
An mRNA or protein-coding branch is rejected. The family label is rRNA, and the compact length plus RFAM annotation makes coding interpretation less useful for the model.

The target merges ribosomal context with secondary-structure expectation. For de novo RNA medicine design, the transferable lesson is to preserve functional RNA class and structural constraints separately from raw nucleotide identity.
Represent the sample as a 5S rRNA family graph: a short structured noncoding RNA with ribosomal context and family-conditioned secondary-structure constraints, not a protein-coding transcript.

symbolic_payload.answer: 5S rRNA structured noncoding RNA family record

edges.causal_semantics: The RFAM row supplies the family label and length.
The 5S_rRNA label activates ribosomal function reasoning.
The RNA family label activates structural expectation.
The rRNA annotation rejects protein-coding interpretation.
Ribosomal role enters the final target.
Structural expectation enters the final target.
The rejected coding branch prevents class confusion.
Merged class and structure constraints determine the answer.

targets.answer: Use a 5S rRNA structured-noncoding-RNA graph with ribosomal context and secondary-structure expectations; reject mRNA/protein-coding interpretation.

must_not_claim: exact structure solved from row alone
